set.body: Split from SourceRef (bd-01M3EXX8KSK97QEKXSZ43DTVYV), whose Phase 1 (fixation CSV and trial inventory: SourceIdentity, ImportSpec, ledger v4, SourceComparison, codecs, laws) is on main. SourceFormat has only FixationCsv and TrialInventoryCsv, so EyeLink ASC inputs have no semantic source identity, and custom key readers are refused for replay. Add an ASC SourceIdentity with codecs, laws and replay.
set.title: SourceRef phase 2: semantic source identity for ASC inputs
